notes.title: The amount of card combinations in this game is going to be insane!
notes.content:
I wanted to share how the cards work in CardCaster. There are two different types of cards: modifier cards and ability cards.
Any modifier cards that are played, such as fire or electrify, will apply their effect to the next ability card that is played. You can stack multiple modifier cards on a single ability card, allowing for many combinations of attacks.
Ability cards allow you to perform an ability, such as turning your sword massive or shooting daggers for a certain amount of time. Many abilities can be used together. For example, if you play the card to turn your sword massive, then the card to make it swing, you got a massive swinging sword. If you played a fire modifier before that, you'll be swinging around a massive fire sword.
There are some abilities that cannot be modified like ghost and teleport because they do not have an attack or other aspects to modify.

I am a little concerned about the exponentially increasing number of card combinations I will have to make sure work without bugs, but whatever.

Thanks for reading! I'd really appreciate it for you to wishlist if you haven't already!
